products.name: Orthopedic Memory Foam Dog Bed
products.short: Joint-friendly support for senior and large dogs.
products.description: Joint-friendly support for senior and large dogs, wrapped in a soft, machine-washable cover with a gentle bolster for resting heads.

products.name: Donut Calming Cat Bed
products.short: A cozy donut that helps anxious cats feel safe.
products.description: A plush, self-warming donut shape that gives cats a sense of security. Lightly padded rim supports the head and neck during naps.

products.name: Reflective Nylon Dog Leash
products.short: High-visibility leash for safe night walks.
products.description: A durable woven-nylon leash with reflective stitching for low-light safety. Padded handle and a rust-proof swivel clip keep walks comfortable.

products.name: Soft Padded No-Pull Harness
products.short: Gentle control that protects the neck.
products.description: A breathable mesh harness with soft padding and a front D-ring to reduce pulling. Adjustable straps fit most breeds from XS to XL.

products.name: Durable Rope Chew Toy
products.short: Tough cotton rope that cleans teeth while playing.
products.description: Braided natural-cotton rope that satisfies the urge to chew and helps reduce plaque. Knotted ends make tug-of-war easy on the hands.

products.name: Squeaky Plush Toy Set
products.description: A value set of three soft plush toys with built-in squeakers. Varied shapes keep curious pets engaged and are gentle on teeth and gums.

products.name: Automatic Pet Water Fountain
products.short: Circulating filtered water that pets drink more.
products.description: A quiet pump circulates water through a carbon filter, encouraging pets to stay hydrated. BPA-free reservoir with easy-disassemble parts.

products.name: Stainless Double Feeder Bowl
products.description: A heavy non-slip base holds two removable stainless bowls for food and water. Dishwasher-safe and resistant to rust and odors.
